about_short_description.short_description: Metal is a data-driven platform that help founders identify, research, and connect with investors and manage fundraising workflows.

product.name: Investor Search Intelligence
product.description: A tool to identify investors that match a company's stage, sector, and geography using detailed filters and system recommendations.

product.name: Investor Qualification via Empirical Precision
product.description: Analyzes historical investment patterns of investors to assess their relevance for a company's current fundraising stage.

product.name: Similar Companies Algorithm
product.description: Identifies venture-backed companies similar to a user's company to find investors who have previously invested in those companies.

product.name: Intro Pathways Network Intelligence
product.description: Uses LinkedIn, Gmail, and other data sources to map warm introduction paths from a user's network to target investors.

identifier.value: Investor CRM with Real-Time Fundraising Guidance

product.name: Investor CRM with Real-Time Fundraising Guidance
product.description: A CRM tool that provides real-time data and historical venture deal insights to guide founders through the fundraising process.

product.name: Investing Thesis Discovery
product.description: Identifies the core investment themes and sector focus of individual investors based on their historical venture investments.
